heads: own cosine on joint equal-norm DINO and existing CLIP features
selection: Validation only; no test or seven known errors used for fitting, epoch choice, temperature or thresholds.
test: One fixed-candidate evaluation only after validation passes. Same reused public set; not new phone exam. Whole/phone top1 and correct confirmations must not decrease; confirmation precision >=95% and no >1pp drop.
known_error_review: Release veto for new confident wrong make; do not choose another candidate using known errors.
data: Existing frozen grouped v26 dataset; generic Apache-2.0 DINOv2 backbone only; own supervised heads. No new downloads of labelled automobile classifiers.
colour: Separately compare only own trained colour decisions or own documented algorithms. No colour shortcut tied to make or filename.
production: Preserve running2.6 and sealed ZIPs. No release unless quantitative gates and practical error review permit. Do not claim every electric model learned.

features: DINO generic image features plus own paint statistics
same features plus probabilities of existing own trained colour heads
colour_policy.public_cohort: stable SHA-sorted 50/train and20/validation per colour from preserved VCoR splits;20/test only after validation passes; exclude dHash-near crosssplit pairs
colour_policy.own: Existing24 colour-labelled own TRAIN crops only; no seven new error labels fitted
colour_policy.selection: mean whole/stress validation, whole not worse and synthetic-stress gain>=2pp over existing 2.6 colour heads. No test based choice. Exact two fits only.
colour_policy.limitations: Historical VCoR author/vehicle identities unavailable; split+near-duplicate separation is not certified independent vehicle grouping. No new blind-phone accuracy claim.
